options.name: drift
options.notes: Schema is Dart table classes; build_runner emits typed DAOs/companions and migration steps are produced from schema versions. Runs identically on mobile and web (sqlite3.wasm + drift_worker) with no code forks. The best fit for a deterministic emitter.

options.name: sqflite
options.notes: Mature native plugin, but schema is raw SQL strings plus hand-rolled row->object mapping, and web requires the experimental ffi shim. Drift already wraps sqflite natively, so it adds nothing over drift.

options.name: shared_preferences
options.notes: Key-value store with a web (IndexedDB/localStorage) implementation; fine for settings, not a data layer. Full CRUD over entities means bespoke serialization per entity, so it's only useful as a secondary 'none/pseudo' backend mode.

options.name: hive_ce
options.notes: Box store with typed adapters generated by hive_ce_generator; persists to IndexedDB on web and is actively maintained, though its web path has occasionally lagged behind Flutter/Dart releases. Easy keyed/boxed storage but no relational queries or real migrations.

options.name: objectbox
options.notes: Fast typed object store with automatic schema evolution and codegen, but has no web target. Fails the web requirement outright; revisit only if web is deprioritized.

options.name: isar
options.notes: Strong codegen and web/IndexedDB support, but the project is discontinued and unmaintained, making it an unacceptable long-term dependency risk for generated apps.

options.name: in-memory
options.notes: Ephemeral store with no persistence. Useful only as a generator 'no-database' test/preview backend mode, never for production. Lowest complexity but zero offline value.

recommendation: Support drift (SQL) and hive_ce (NoSQL) as the v1 backends. Drift is the only mature SQL option with real web support via sqlite3.wasm, is fully schema-codegen-driven (Dart table classes to typed DAOs and migration code), and covers mobile with the same API. hive_ce adds NoSQL with web IndexedDB persistence and generated typed adapters through the same build_runner flow at a fraction of drift's ceremony. Defer objectbox (no web), isar (discontinued), sqflite (no web and superseded by drift natively), and shared_preferences/in-memory (not real data layers, expose later as a settings/test backend mode).
